decisions.reason: As a newly launched finishing machine with its own product page, it is likely still in the active sales build-up phase and too early for a German distributor to withdraw it.
The product received prominent home-page placement and a quantified Germany premiere in 2023, which signals strategic importance and expected continued market push.
Although evidence of market traction is limited, a dedicated page suggests it fills a defined workflow role and would usually be kept at least another year in this industry.
A new B2-format multifinisher highlighted on the home page is likely a flagship offer for commercial print customers, so management would normally continue backing it.
A hybrid saddle stitcher is more specialized and may face a narrower buyer base, but as a fresh 2023 launch with its own page it would still likely remain in the portfolio.
The cited customer installation shows real use in the market, and add-on modules that extend existing systems are typically retained when they support cross-selling and installed-base value.
